title: SEC EDGAR (XBRL financial data, filings, full-text search)
questions: a public company's annual revenue and net income over ten years
total assets of every public company in 2023
recent insider (Form 4) filings for a company
list of a company's 8-K filings since 2024

manual.how: Open the JSON links in INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser (data.sec.gov and efts.sec.gov accept a browser) and save each under the name shown, or use EDGAR full-text search (https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index is behind https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) and company pages (https://www.sec.gov/edgar/searchedgar/companysearch); upload the files.

cache.why: Filings arrive continuously and companyfacts change with each filing; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: EDGAR filings are public records and SEC data are U.S. government works (17 U.S.C. 105); SEC's fair-access policy limits request rates, not reuse.

citation: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR {dataset}, data.sec.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Fiscal or calendar years? XBRL facts carry the company's fiscal year (fy) and period dates; the frames API realigns to calendar periods.
As first reported or latest restated values? Each 10-K repeats and may restate prior years; frames_only keeps the latest filed value per period.
